desc: Implement precomputation of factorials, inverse factorials, and powers of (m-1) up to n in `__init__`.
Implement `nCr(n, r)` helper using precomputed tables.
Compute and return `C(n-1, k) * m % MOD * pow(m-1, n-k-1, MOD) % MOD`, handling exponent 0 correctly.
Test on the three provided examples and small brute-force cases.
